content: Visit Norfolk what's on: list view + map view, keyword search, start/end date, category (incl Fairs & Markets, Family, Christmas, Bonfire Night), interest type (Family Friendly, Dog Friendly), location dropdown incl Attleborough, accessibility & sustainability criteria filters, Events Submission form. Visit Wymondham (neighbour town, Modern Events Calendar plugin): category filter incl 'Family Friendly' and 'Free', per-card Facebook/Twitter/Email share, load more, 'List your event for FREE', newsletter signup, JSON-LD. Eventbrite Attleborough page mostly shows Norwich events with save/share per card.
